gloss_en: Editing an IFC is painful: walls turn into proxies, properties are read-only, GUIDs change after bulk edits.
title_original: Problemi comuni nell'editing dei file IFC e come risolverli
question_paraphrase: ho un IFC ricevuto dal collega, devo modificare le proprieta ma il viewer e solo lettura e i muri sono finiti come proxy, come faccio senza rompere i GUID?
phrasing_notes: vendor article framed as a how-to; terms 'proxy', 'Pset', 'round-tripping' left in English
answer_summary: IFC is an exchange not authoring format; use dedicated IFC editors, fix export (MVD, class mapping) upstream, report via BCF, avoid explode/bulk edits that change GUIDs.

gloss_en: What are the differences between Revit and IFC for interoperability, and what is lost on export?
title_original: IFC VS RVT: quali sono le principali differenze
question_paraphrase: cosa si perde esportando da Revit in IFC? le famiglie e le relazioni vengono mappate bene?
phrasing_notes: short conceptual question; vendor pushes plugin
answer_summary: Export may miss nuances; family/relationship structures map imperfectly; different software interprets IFC differently; article promotes usBIM.revolution plugin (vendor claim).

gloss_en: How to load an IFC class mapping file in Revit/Archicad so IFC entities are recognized on import.
title_original: IFC class mapping file
question_paraphrase: come carico il file di mappatura classi IFC in Revit prima di aprire l'IFC cosi le porte restano porte?
phrasing_notes: procedural; menu paths File > Open > IFC Options
answer_summary: Load mapping via IFC Options before opening; Archicad uses IFC Translators (IFC Properties vs ARCHICAD Properties); Edificius auto-recognizes; keep add-in updated.

gloss_en: When is BIM mandatory in Italian public procurement (over 2 million euro, from 1 Jan 2025) and which open format is required?
title_original: Obbligo BIM negli appalti pubblici: guida completa
question_paraphrase: da quando e obbligatorio il BIM negli appalti e sopra che soglia? serve per forza l'IFC?
phrasing_notes: regulatory vocabulary: soglia, DOCFAP, ACDat, stazione appaltante
answer_summary: Mandatory above 2M EUR for new works/interventions since 1 Jan 2025 (D.Lgs 209/2024); open non-proprietary formats, IFC ISO 16739 as reference; CI/oGI/pGI documents; MIT opinions on transitional rules.

gloss_en: My IFC models do not line up / float; how to set origin and georeference IfcSite before export?
title_original: IFC coordinate system
question_paraphrase: i modelli IFC non si sovrappongono, uno e fuori di km, dove imposto origine e coordinate del sito prima di esportare?
phrasing_notes: typical 'fuori di km' complaint; menu paths per software
answer_summary: Define project origin, georeference IfcSite (lat/long/elev) in each tool, export, verify IfcSite in viewer; IFC4 IfcCoordinateReferenceSystem (WGS84, ED50, Roma40, EPSG).

gloss_en: How to write a capitolato informativo (EIR) with open data formats and ISO 19650 CDE.
title_original: Capitolato Informativo: come redigerlo con la metodologia BIM
question_paraphrase: devo scrivere il capitolato informativo per una gara, cosa metto su formati e livelli di dettaglio?
phrasing_notes: formal; mentions formati aperti non proprietari
answer_summary: Specify open non-proprietary formats, deliverable types, CDE per ISO 19650; avoid ambiguity; coordinate with Codice contratti and 2026 MIT guidelines.

gloss_en: How do I create an IFC file and which version (2x3 or 4) should I choose?
title_original: Come creare un file IFC
question_paraphrase: come si esporta un IFC? meglio 2x3 o IFC4?
answer_summary: File > Esportazioni > Formato IFC; choose version and MVD; ensure properties assigned; validate with viewer/checker.

gloss_en: How to check required properties and values (e.g. FireRating) in an IFC against a template.
title_original: BIM validation di modelli in formato IFC
question_paraphrase: come verifico che porte e muri abbiano FireRating e trasmittanza prima di consegnare l'IFC?
answer_summary: Check property existence/values vs template, model conformity before clash/code checking, clean non-shareable properties.

gloss_en: How do I detect what changed between two IFC versions of a model?
title_original: Come rilevare le modifiche nei modelli IFC
question_paraphrase: ho due revisioni dello stesso IFC, come vedo cosa e cambiato (aggiunti, rimossi, modificati)?
answer_summary: Load both, align coordinates, compare geometry+properties, color-coded diff, export PDF/CSV/BCF; watch tolerances and schema differences.

gloss_en: What do the 2026 MIT guidelines on digital information management (GID) require: roles, ACDat, formats, model prevailing over 2D?
title_original: Linee guida 2026 per la gestione informativa digitale (GID)
question_paraphrase: cosa dicono le linee guida MIT 2026 su ACDat, ruoli e formato IFC? il modello prevale sul 2D?
answer_summary: GID mandatory over 2M EUR; BIM Manager, CDE Manager, BIM Coordinator; neutral formats like IFC; CI -> oGI -> pGI; model prevails over 2D unless declared otherwise.

gloss_en: Revit to IFC conversion setup: class mapping, IfcExportAs, MVD, shared coordinates, custom Psets via schedules or parameter file.
title_original: Conversione modello BIM in IFC5: come convertire un modello Revit
question_paraphrase: esporto da Revit ma i parametri custom non finiscono nei Pset, come li mappo?
answer_summary: Map categories, override with IfcExportAs, choose MVD and coordinates base, use schedules or parameter mapping txt for custom Psets, verify in viewer.

gloss_en: Where is a wall's FireRating in an IFC and how to edit it (Pset_WallCommon)?
title_original: Proprieta IFC: dal muro a FireRating
question_paraphrase: dove trovo il FireRating di un muro in un IFC e come lo modifico?
answer_summary: Property lives in Pset_WallCommon; edit value vs property name differently.

gloss_en: Where are units declared in an IFC and why schema validity does not guarantee correct measures?
title_original: IFC in pratica #3. Unita di misura
question_paraphrase: dove sono dichiarate le unita nell'IFC? il file valido ma le misure sono sballate
answer_summary: IfcUnitAssignment declares units; valid schema != correct values.

gloss_en: Does Piano Casa 2026 change the BIM obligation (art. 43)?
title_original: Piano Casa 2026: cosa cambia per edilizia convenzionata, appalti e BIM
question_paraphrase: col Piano Casa 2026 l'obbligo BIM cambia o resta art. 43?
answer_summary: Obligation depends on art. 43 prerequisites; verify case by case.

gloss_en: Beyond 3D BIM: systemic vision, mentions IDS requirements.
title_original: Il futuro delle costruzioni oltre il BIM 3D
question_paraphrase: ha senso il BIM solo 3D? servono requisiti IDS?
answer_summary: Argues for data-driven systemic approach with IDS.

gloss_en: IFC 4.3 approved as ISO standard: what changes for infrastructure?
title_original: IFC 4.3: il formato standard per l'interoperabilita openBIM
question_paraphrase: IFC 4.3 cosa cambia per strade e ferrovie? i software lo supportano?
answer_summary: IFC4.3 final standard adds infrastructure; support not universal.

gloss_en: What is IFC 2x3 Coordination View 2.0?
title_original: IFC Coordination View
question_paraphrase: cos'e la Coordination View 2.0 e quando usarla?
answer_summary: MVD subset for architecture/structure/MEP coordination, certified in Revit.

gloss_en: Is the offerta di gestione informativa (oGI) mandatory in BIM tenders? (Consiglio di Stato 6834/2026)
title_original: Appalti BIM: l'Offerta di Gestione Informativa e obbligatoria?
question_paraphrase: in gara serve per forza l'oGI? se non la presento vengo escluso?
answer_summary: Court ruling discussed; oGI role in CI-oGI-pGI chain.

gloss_en: Does the 10% BIM fee increase apply to site management and CSE?
title_original: BIM, maggiorazione del 10% anche per direzione lavori e CSE
question_paraphrase: la maggiorazione del 10% per il BIM vale anche per DL e CSE?
answer_summary: Per ANAC opinion extended to DL and safety coordination.

gloss_en: BIM requirements in RTI: individual professional or working group?
title_original: Requisiti BIM negli RTI
question_paraphrase: nei raggruppamenti il requisito BIM lo deve avere il singolo o il gruppo?
answer_summary: Discusses assessment of BIM requirements for groups.

gloss_en: Is BIM mandatory to complete an unfinished work?
title_original: C'e l'obbligo di appalto BIM anche per completare un'opera incompiuta?
question_paraphrase: per completare un'opera incompiuta serve il BIM?
answer_summary: Obligation if remaining works exceed 2M EUR.

gloss_en: How to convert a DWG to IFC simply.
title_original: Come convertire un file DWG in IFC in modo semplice
question_paraphrase: ho solo il DWG, come lo converto in IFC?
answer_summary: Four-step conversion with a free tool; limited semantics.

gloss_en: How to get 2D plans, sections, elevations in DXF from an IFC.
title_original: La guida completa per convertire file IFC in DXF
question_paraphrase: dall'IFC come estraggo piante e sezioni in DXF?
answer_summary: Generate 2D views from model and export CAD formats.

gloss_en: BCF markups in openBIM workflows.
title_original: Markups BCF nei workflow OpenBIM
question_paraphrase: come uso i BCF per segnalare errori nell'IFC all'autore?
answer_summary: BCF links issues to elements, exchanged across tools.

gloss_en: IFC model: what is it and how is BIM linked to IFC?
title_original: IFC model cos'e? Qual e il legame BIM-IFC?
question_paraphrase: che differenza c'e tra BIM e IFC?
answer_summary: IFC is open neutral format for BIM data exchange.

gloss_en: Architecture of an IFC file: IfcObjectDefinition.
title_original: Architettura file IFC (parte 1): IfcObjectDefinition
question_paraphrase: come e strutturato un file IFC, IfcObjectDefinition e relazioni?
answer_summary: Explains entity hierarchy.

gloss_en: usBIM.checker for information verification of the model.
title_original: usBIM.checker, il BIM tool per la verifica informativa
question_paraphrase: con che tool verifico i requisiti informativi del modello IFC?
answer_summary: Rule-based checker for IFC properties.

gloss_en: First observations on the 2017 BIM decree: obligation, capitolati informativi, exchange formats.
title_original: Obbligo di adozione del BIM, capitolati informativi e formati di interscambio
question_paraphrase: il decreto BIM 560/2017 impone IFC o formati aperti?
answer_summary: Decree requires interoperable open formats; phased deadlines.

gloss_en: Count proxies and their Revit categories
prompt: quanti IfcBuildingElementProxy ci sono nel modello? da che categorie Revit arrivano?
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy, group by ObjectType/Revit category, suggest class mapping fixes.

gloss_en: Which doors lack FireRating
prompt: dimmi quali porte non hanno il FireRating nel Pset_DoorCommon
expected_behavior: List IfcDoor lacking FireRating in Pset_DoorCommon with ids/names/levels.

gloss_en: Check IfcSite coordinates and CRS
prompt: i modelli non si sovrappongono. controlla IfcSite lat/long/quota e il CRS e dimmi se l'origine e sballata
expected_behavior: Read IfcSite RefLatitude/RefLongitude/RefElevation, IfcMapConversion/CRS, placement offsets; report anomalies.

gloss_en: Compare two IFC revisions
prompt: confronta rev A e rev B, cosa e stato aggiunto/rimosso/modificato per GUID?
expected_behavior: Diff models by GlobalId: added/removed/changed attributes and properties; summary by class.

gloss_en: Elements without storey
prompt: ci sono elementi non contenuti in nessun piano (IfcBuildingStorey)?
expected_behavior: Find elements lacking IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure to storey, list them.

gloss_en: Wall area per storey
prompt: dammi l'area dei muri esterni per piano, da Qto
expected_behavior: Sum NetSideArea from Qto_WallBaseQuantities where IsExternal, grouped by storey.

gloss_en: Check model vs capitolato informativo requirements
prompt: verifica se il modello rispetta il capitolato informativo: classificazione, materiali, FireRating su tutti i muri
expected_behavior: Check required properties/classification across classes and report non-conformances.

gloss_en: Units used in model
prompt: in che unita e il file? mm o metri? cosa dice IfcUnitAssignment
expected_behavior: Report IfcUnitAssignment length/area/volume units; warn of mismatches.

gloss_en: Reclassify proxies as columns
prompt: i proxy con nome 'Pilastro' mettili come IfcColumn
expected_behavior: Change predefined type/class of matching proxies to IfcColumn, report count, keep GlobalIds where possible.

gloss_en: Custom parameters missing from IFC export
prompt: da Revit esporto IFC ma i miei parametri condivisi non ci sono nei Pset, perche?
expected_behavior: Explain user-defined property set file / export options 'export schedules as Psets'; shared parameter requirements.

gloss_en: Which IFC version/MVD for tender
prompt: per la gara cosa esporto, 2x3 CV2.0 o IFC4 RV?
expected_behavior: Explain 2x3 CV2.0 vs IFC4 Reference View, check capitolato, tool support.

gloss_en: List materials per type
prompt: elenco materiali usati dai muri con relativa quantita
expected_behavior: List IfcMaterial/layer sets associated to IfcWall with counts.

gloss_en: Summarize model for BIM obligation deliverable
prompt: riassumimi il modello: discipline, n. elementi per classe, livelli, per il verbale di consegna
expected_behavior: Produce model inventory by class, storey, discipline, schema version.

gloss_en: Rooms with area and name
prompt: lista locali con superficie e nome, quelli senza nome segnali
expected_behavior: List IfcSpace with Name and area; flag missing names.

gloss_en: Terminals not in a system
prompt: terminali impianto non collegati a nessun sistema?
expected_behavior: Find MEP terminals without IfcRelAssignsToGroup system membership.

gloss_en: Model shows wrong colors / z-fighting
prompt: nel viewer i colori sono sballati e c'e z-fighting, e il modello o il viewer?
expected_behavior: Check styled items/materials, overlapping duplicate geometry in model; explain viewer artifacts.

gloss_en: Slab volumes per level
prompt: volume solai per piano, mi servono per il computo oggi
expected_behavior: Sum slab volume per storey from Qto or computed geometry; note source.
